name: mythras-gm
description: Run persistent tabletop RPG campaigns as Gamesmaster using Mythras Imperative rules, with all game state in TypeDB. Includes dice engine, combat resolution, character generation, campaign publishing, and worldbuilding persistence.

system.description: Standalone: the skill's SessionStart hook starts TypeDB (Docker) and provisions its own 'mythras' database -- no other plugin required. Novelization PDF builds additionally need pandoc and typst (brew install pandoc typst).
